items.item_text: As a member of the Department of Nutrition, you will perform a variety of custodial, cleaning, and sanitation duties to maintain a clean, safe, and sanitary environment. Under the direct supervision of the Patient Services Manager and Patient Services Supervisors, you will be responsible for maintaining assigned areas and supporting daily departmental operations.
Sweep, mop, scrub, strip, and wax floors as assigned.
Clean and sanitize walls, doors, windows, light fixtures, and other designated surfaces.
Empty waste bins and clean, sanitize, and reline trash containers and linen hampers.
Wash and steam-clean rubber floor mats.
Clean, store, and maintain custodial equipment and report any malfunctions to the supervisor on duty.
Wash dishes, pans, utensils, and small equipment in accordance with established procedures.
Follow all established safety, infection prevention, and sanitation policies and procedures.
Ability to read and write in English and follow oral and written instructions.
Ability to stand for extended periods and repeatedly stretch, bend, stoop, and reach.
Ability to work in hot, cold, and/or wet environments.
Ability to lift up to 40 pounds and push loaded carts weighing up to 350 pounds.
Ability to adjust to fluctuating workloads and adhere to established production schedules.
Ability to follow safe food-handling practices and maintain good personal hygiene.
Ability to comply with departmental dress code requirements and work in a smoke-free environment.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively with coworkers, customers, supervisors, and managers.
